sourceSelection: All inventoried PBP seasons; weekly player/team stats; all season and weekly roster assets; participation; FTN charting; snap counts; combined NGS categories; players, drafts, trades, schedule. No aggregate/weekly duplication.

definitions.rawRows: Every original PBP row, including administrative and nullified rows.
definitions.actionRows: Published play_type in run, pass, punt, kickoff, field_goal, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike. Includes kneels/spikes/special teams; a reproducible action-row proxy, not proof of physical snaps.
definitions.inventoryCheckedAt: Local verification against selected inventory metadata. Provider inventory fetch times and retained/live/HTML modes are recorded in inventories; a local verification does not establish a fresh upstream check.
definitions.candidateCompleteGames: Terminal marker, nonempty probability evidence and PBP running/final scores reconciled with schedule. An audit candidate only; existing publication eligibility remains authoritative.
